name: Matter Folder and Routing
description: Legal intake files each incoming document in its own matter folder and asks the requester where it goes next. Create Folder makes (or reuses) the matter folder under /Parties/, named from the incoming Params, and stores it in a new Folder variable; the document is copied there. A Routing task asks the requester (all assignees must respond) to pick Standard review or Escalate to Legal; the task email comes from the requester, reminders go after 2 days and then every 24 hours from day 3, and the pick and the comment go into Text variables. A rule on the pick sets the workflow output.
